admission.justification: A nested test omitted from the scan could bypass the shared protection on a future test run.

applicability: The repository settings-writer regression scan over mcp/tests and mcp/test_support.
conditions: Test-prefixed Python files are included recursively, not excluded as implicitly isolated.
A direct settings-path writer outside the guard must fail the scan.
exclusions: This syntactic scan is not a general Python security proof.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_user_settings_guard.py (the two tests named in found_at); notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/260928-MIK-L113-repair-of-round-1-attempt-A2-37.md, section 2

statement: The check that every write of the user's settings path goes through the guard reads every Python file under `mcp/tests`, test files at any depth included, and fails on a test file that writes directly.
